name: globe
title: Globe
description: A monochrome dotted WebGL globe on cobe, in three variants: minimal landmass; cities, where the world's largest metros rise as dots sized by population and each breathes on its own rhythm, with names that fade in as they turn to face you; and network, hubs joined by arcs with a ping travelling between them. Drag to spin it in any direction; it keeps the throw and settles back to its idle turn.
